proposed.text: A commercial building's service entrance is limited to 75 A at 380V three-phase, 0.89 PF. A load addition study shows current demand is 35 kW. How much additional demand load (in kW) can be added without exceeding the 75 A limit?
proposed.rationale: Maximum apparent power at 75 A, 380 V, three-phase: S = sqrt(3)*V*I = 1.732*380*75 = 49,362 VA. Maximum real power at 0.89 PF: P_max = S*PF = 49,362*0.89 = 43,932 W (~43.9 kW). Additional demand allowed = 43.9 - 35 = 8.9 kW. The original '17.2 kW' answer used an incorrect denominator and is wrong. Source: Philippine Electrical Code three-phase power formula (I = P/(sqrt(3)*V*PF)).
